name: HomeBox
description: Home inventory for the things you own, where they are and what they cost

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database with your items, the photos and files you attach, and this install's own key (secrets.env). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: HomeBox web UI and API, published on host as 6781

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: HBOX_OPTIONS_ALLOW_REGISTRATION
variables.description: Lets people make an account on the sign-in page. Set it to false after you and your household have registered; you can still invite people from your home's settings.

variables.name: HBOX_WEB_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE
variables.description: The biggest file you can attach (photos, receipts, manuals), in MB.
